question: Where can I get the road network (geometry) of Spain, with road category, owner and traffic volume (annual average daily traffic)?

answer.summary: No single national file has geometry, category, owner and AADT for all Spanish roads. The Ministry of Transport's HERMES ArcGIS REST service gives State-network (RCE) section lines with owner, road type and IMD (vehicles/day, 2020-2024 per section) as open API. IGN's IGR-RT covers all roads of every owner with category and owner but no traffic. IMD on regional roads is published region by region (Valencia, Catalonia, Navarre, Castilla y Leon tested).
main_caveats: HERMES holds several years per section: filter Dato_hasta (epoch ms) to the newest, or you get duplicates (23,113 rows, 11,338 unique road+PK ranges). Row id 0 is empty. Valido_hasta is empty in all rows.
In HERMES layer 198 IMD_asc/IMD_desc are percentages of the total (they add to 100) although the data dictionary says vehicles/day; IMD_asc is null in 6,443 rows.
HERMES IMD lines cover the State network only (Titular=Estado in 23,046 of 23,112 rows); the station layers (195, 151) return HTTP 400 to every query tried.
IGR-RT is the only nationwide owner/category source but its download is a browser button (link '#'); curl got an empty reply from CNIG. Licence compatible with CC-BY 4.0. No traffic field.
Regional IMD sets differ: Catalonia and Navarre give points at stations, Castilla y Leon has no geometry, Valencia has lines (GML only). Years differ per region.
answer.confidence_reason: HERMES and 4 regional sets were queried and counted; the IGR-RT owner/category files and 12 regions' IMD were not opened or downloaded; ministry site rejects automated clients.

attributes.note: IGR-RT: 9.9M road links via OGC API (3D lines, all owners incl. urban). HERMES: 1,602 RTIG section lines (29,238 km) and 23,112 IMD lines.
HERMES Tipo_de_via (4 values) for RTIG roads; IGR-RT API has only INSPIRE functionalclass/formofway; the clase/orden fields are in files I could not download.
attributes.gap_note: Open the national IGR-RT GeoPackage from CNIG (download button needs a browser) and list the rt_tramo_l fields clase, orden, titular.

attributes.note: HERMES Titular (Estado plus a few regional owners) for RTIG roads; owner of every road is the titular field of IGR-RT files per its data model (files not downloaded).
attributes.gap_note: Same as above: titular values of the national IGR-RT file were not inspected; the API roadlink has no owner field.

how_to_use.example_result: Feature LineString [[-3.6585589,40.5038107],[-3.6583294,40.5042158],...] properties {"Carretera":"A-1","PK_inicio":12,"PK_fin":12.69,"IMD_total":141954,"Pesados":3.00660777,"Titular":"Estado","Dato_hasta":1735603200000}. Count query where=Dato_hasta=DATE '2024-12-31' returned {"count":10412}; with IMD_total>=100000 returned 254.
steps: Page with resultOffset and resultRecordCount=2000 (maxRecordCount 2000, 12 requests for all 23,113 rows); add orderByFields=id and outSR=4326 to get lon/lat.
Drop row id 0 (null attributes, empty geometry). Keep for each (Carretera, PK_inicio, PK_fin) the row with the largest Dato_hasta, or filter Dato_hasta=DATE '2024-12-31' for the 2024 set.
Convert Dato_desde/Dato_hasta from epoch milliseconds. IMD_total is vehicles/day; IMD_asc is a percent.

Category: join layer 0__CARRETERAS/0 (Tipo_de_via, 1,602 line sections) by Carretera and overlapping PK range. Owner: Titular is in both layers. Whole RCE catalogue: HERMES_CARRETERAS/89 (1,303 sections, 26,459 km, with Inicio and Final).
reading_traps: 23,113 rows but only 11,338 distinct road+PK ranges: each section appears once per gauged year (2020-2024); summing lengths gives 53,747 km, double the RCE (26,459 km in layer 89).
IMD_asc and IMD_desc sum to 100 (e.g. 52.21 / 47.79): percentages, contradicting the dictionary text 'vehiculos/dia'; null in 6,443 rows.
Same section, different years can differ a lot: A-1 PK 12-12.69 has IMD_total 183,647 (2021) and 141,954 (2024).
Station layers 3__USO_DE_LA_RED/195 and HERMES_CARRETERAS/151 answer 'Failed to execute query' (HTTP 400) to count and record queries; use the section layers.
Titular is null in 53 IMD rows and 10 rows of the road-type layer; Tipo_de_via is null in 11.

steps: For owner and category use the national road file (CNIG listing, GeoPackage or Shapefile): table rt_tramo_l has titular, orden, clase; rt_catcarreteras_a gives codigo and name; join by id_vial per the data model PDF (ModeloFisico_IGR-RT_V1_9).
titular=1 selects the State network ('El valor 1 ... se refiere especificamente a la Red de Carreteras del Estado').
The OGC API/WFS expose only the INSPIRE view (functionalclass, formofway, lanes): paginate with limit and offset; use skipGeometry=true for counts.
The download control on the CNIG page links to '#' (JavaScript); it was not tested.
reading_traps: API roadlink has no owner and no road code; the first two records returned have fictitious='true' (intersection paths) and functionalclass null.
Whole national road layer has 9,900,688 links in the API including urban streets, tracks and fictitious links; the national file is roads only.
Each ownership or class changes along a road: the catalogue stores titular1..titular4 and clase1..3 per road; locate them in rt_tramo_l.
CNIG endpoints answered curl with an empty reply; the page was read only through WebFetch, so the file download and field values were not verified.

Why the same section's IMD differs strongly between years (A-1 PK 12-12.69: 183,647 in 2021, 141,954 in 2024) cannot be resolved from the service.
